violations.evidence: Credential assigned directly in source code
violations.recommendation: Use a secrets manager or environment variable

violations.description: GitHub Actions workflow grants overly broad permissions
violations.evidence: Workflow sets permissions: write-all instead of least privilege
violations.recommendation: Declare minimal permissions per job (contents: read, etc.)

violations.description: Dependencies are unpinned with no lockfile
violations.evidence: requirements.txt lists bare package names and no poetry.lock/uv.lock/Pipfile.lock is present
violations.recommendation: Pin versions or commit a lockfile appropriate to the package manager

violations.description: No automated tests or CI test execution found
violations.evidence: No tests/ directory or test_*.py files; CI workflow only echoes success
violations.recommendation: Add unit tests and run them as a required CI job
